deviations.name: vs QGD — ...Bb4+ before exchange
deviations.principle: Develop calmly; do not waste time grabbing pawns. Complete development and aim for cxd5 when tactically safe.

planChoices.label: Develop with Nf3 or Bd2; keep the tension
Take on d5 immediately no matter what
planChoices.feedback: Often premature here — Black gets activity with ...Bb4+ and ...Nf6.

planChoices.label: Kick the bishop with a3 and chase it forever
planChoices.feedback: Creates weaknesses and loses time unless you have a concrete follow-up.

deviations.name: vs Classical — 2. Nc3 instead of 3. Nc3 line
deviations.principle: Stick to ...d5 and ...c6 structures; develop knights before chasing pawns.

planChoices.label: Play ...d5 and aim for classical Caro structure
Play ...e5 and turn it into a French
planChoices.feedback: Not your repertoire — you play Caro with ...c6.
